value.rationale: Natural two-C7 theta graph at scale 4 exhibits two new mod-two second-homology classes absent in the union of the intrinsic Čech nerves of its two constituents. This gives a concrete homological obstruction to naïve long-overlap metric Čech gluing, precisely motivated by the published short-gluing problem; not an arbitrary parametrized count.
